_comment: Seed components for the Motorola Signature (vantage) integration layer. resolve_components.py expands each seed into the smallest closure of stock files and writes proprietary-files.txt.

telephony-ims.description: Qualcomm IMS service (VoLTE / VoWiFi / ViLTE / SMS over IMS) as shipped by Motorola. Bound as the MMTel ImsService through a com.android.phone overlay.

telephony-carrier.description: Motorola APN database. Stock keeps it at /product/etc/apns-conf.xml; AOSP's TelephonyProvider prefers that path over /system/etc/apns-conf.xml.

camera.description: Motorola Camera (com.motorola.camera5) with the Motorola signature-permission host it depends on.
camera._native_note: The camera manifest lists ~95 optional native libraries for several SoCs. On this firmware they are either AOSP system libraries, vendor libraries (reachable only when listed in /vendor/etc/public.libraries.txt) or absent; none has to be ported. validate-camera.py reports the split.

audio-call-parameters.description: Qualcomm/Motorola implementation of android.media.audio.IHalAdapterVendorExtension. With this phone's AIDL audio HAL, key=value parameters such as vsid and call_state reach the HAL only through it; stock audioserver loads it, here AOSP's audio parameter parser service does (audio/vendorext/README.md).
